    Basic Information
    Description
    This ingot originates from one of the Alchemy mines that once existed around the world. The value of such ingots corresponds to how deep inside the Alchemy mine they were found. Many gold ones such as this one would have been excavated from the innermost depths of the mines.
    Attributes
    A lump of gold that can be exchanged for 80,000 Zeni.
